Subject: MAP & Eval — Acceptance test catalog and signoff ops

Hi Asha —

Great meeting this morning. As promised, I sketched a compact acceptance-test catalog and the operational signoff flow so we can avoid ambiguity during your two-week eval. High-level goals and exit gates below so we’re explicit:

1) Success criteria (must pass all):
- Functional: inference accuracy on our shared evaluation set >= 92% top-1 match over labeled intent pairs.
- Performance: p95 token latency < 900ms and sustained throughput >= 60 req/s under your baseline concurrency.
- Cost parity: projected per-1M token cost within 20% of your target threshold (we’ll share a simulated burn rate).
- Safety/regulatory: no PII leakage in sampling (zero failures across 500 random prompts).

2) Exit gates (what triggers signoff):
- Smoke: all smoke tests green for 3 consecutive days (scripts attached).
- Stakeholder: engineering + product + security provide written approval (email OK).
- Contractual: procurement confirms MSA redlines are acceptable or docuSign executed.

3) Acceptance tests (owners & artifacts):
- Functional evaluation harness (owner: Marissa) — run full eval suite, attach results CSV and confusion/breakdown report.
- Performance soak (owner: Ben) — 48h load run with traces; provide p50/p95/p99 and kernel-level tail spikes.
- Security checklist (owner: Tom at Medpliance) — gap list mapped to our SOC2 summary.
- Data handling verification (owner: Asha) — sample logs, KV cache behavior, and retention proof.

I attached the first draft of the MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) and a small smoke script bundle (eval-smoke-scripts.yml). Can you confirm these criteria align with your internal success definition and timeline? If so, we’ll schedule the test windows and assign owners in HubSpot.

Target timeline (proposed):
- Jul 22–24: test config + map finalization
- Jul 25–Aug 3: execution window (includes two run attempts for soak and smoke)
- Aug 4–8: evidence review and signoff
- Aug 12: final go/no-go decision and procurement signoff

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP with any changes you request.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0139
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

Thanks Rishi — this is very helpful and close to what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Functional: our labeled set is 3,200 intent pairs; can you confirm you can run the exact set and return per-intent breakdowns?
- Performance: p95 target of 900ms is acceptable; would like p99 reported too (we care about tail spikes during nightly jobs).
- Data handling: we’ll provide a redacted sample dataset and expect your logs to show a clear retention TTL = 30 days for the test.

On timeline: Jul 25–Aug 3 works, but our security team wants to review SOC2 artifacts before the soak. I’m looping Tom (security) and procurement for visibility.

Can Marissa and Ben confirm owners for the harness and soak? If we can lock owners now we’ll schedule the test windows.

Best,
